notes: Logo: vector reconstruction (potrace) of MEAT STOP's own 1275x361 transparent PNG header wordmark 'MEAT STOP®' from meatstop.co.uk. No genuine SVG is published. The source was upscaled 3x (Lanczos) before tracing so the small ® keeps its ring and counter. Two layers: charcoal #202020 letters and a #000000 ®, matching the source pixels. Mean abs diff vs source 5.71. Charcoal on transparent, so it goes on a light plate.
The red MEAT STOP® roundel (TikTok avatar, also on the chef's apron) is a second genuine mark. It was not used as the primary logo because the site header uses the charcoal wordmark.

Reel: 2 video clips and 4 stills, all MEAT STOP's own media. Clip 1 is the only shot of 2.0 s or longer in the 12.7 s homepage HLS hero video (1080x1920). Clip 2 comes from MEAT STOP's own TikTok post 7121257136235040006, which is only available at 576x1024, so it looks soft on the 1280x720 desktop reel. Stills come from meatstop.co.uk.

Gallery photos are MEAT STOP's own site images. photo-06 (from a social-post screenshot) was cropped on the right to remove an Instagram carousel arrow. photo-08 was cropped at the bottom to remove carousel dots. The people shown in photo-03, photo-06 and photo-08 are not identified, and it is not confirmed whether they are staff or customers.
photo-09 shows a fried chicken burger from a 2024 post. It is not on the current 2026 menu.
Excluded: the sauce-pour screenshot (224557b3…, origin unconfirmed), two low-resolution duplicate studio shots (049ab256…, 2a71d3b3…), logos and favicons.
